description: The file contains server-side C# code for a web page in an online examination system. It handles loading theory exam questions from a database, displaying them, managing timer countdown, and submitting answered questions back to the database. It also features navigation controls and user session management.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam.aspx page managing the exam lifecycle, UI interactions, and database operations.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, initializes questions, session, and timer based on session data.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on provided course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Inserts the user's answers into the database, updates course queue, and marks the exam as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display or indicates when time is up.
